events.content:
Implemented the post creation flow. The Server Action in [app/actions.ts](/workspace/app/actions.ts:6) saves the post, then calls `updateTag('posts')`. This expires the cached list immediately, so the next read waits for fresh data instead of serving stale content.

The list is tagged in [app/posts.ts](/workspace/app/posts.ts:4), and [app/page.tsx](/workspace/app/page.tsx:4) now displays posts and provides a creation form. I verified the production build and submitted a post: it appeared in the action response and on the next page load.

Posts are stored in a local JSON file for this scaffold. A deployment with multiple server instances needs shared storage.

shellCommands.command: /bin/bash -lc 'cat package.json && cat app/page.tsx && cat app/layout.tsx && cat next.config.ts'
/bin/bash -lc 'for f in /AGENTS.md /workspace/AGENTS.md /workspace/app/AGENTS.md; do if [ -f "$f" ]; then printf '"'%s\\n' \""'$f"; cat "$f"; fi; done'

/bin/bash -lc "rg -n \"posts|cacheTag|revalidateTag|updateTag|server action|use server|prisma|drizzle|fetch\" --glob '"'!package-lock.json'"' --glob '"'!node_modules/**'"' --glob '"'!__agent_eval__/**'"' .; git status --short; rg --files app"
/bin/bash -lc 'node --version; cat tsconfig.json; cat .gitignore; git log -1 --oneline; git show HEAD:package.json'
/bin/bash -lc "rg -n \"function updateTag|declare function updateTag|function cacheTag|declare function cacheTag\" node_modules/next/dist -g '*.d.ts' | head -30"
/bin/bash -lc "git status --short; sed -n '1,160p' app/actions.ts; sed -n '1,160p' app/posts.ts; sed -n '1,200p' lib/posts.ts; sed -n '1,160p' app/page.tsx; cat next.config.ts"
/bin/bash -lc 'git diff -- app/page.tsx next.config.ts tsconfig.json .gitignore; git status --short'
/bin/bash -lc 'cat next-env.d.ts; git diff --stat; git status --short; ls -la data'

/bin/bash -lc "python3 - <<'PY'
from pathlib import Path
post_file = Path('/workspace/data/posts.json')
post_file.unlink()
post_file.parent.rmdir()
PY"
/bin/bash -lc 'git diff --check; git status --short; git diff -- tsconfig.json .gitignore'
